editorial:
Imagine being a straight-edge guy with a steady job and a clean record, only to have your whole life flip upside down in a single afternoon. That is exactly what happens to Guillaume. He is a decent kid who stays away from trouble, but everything changes when he finds his dad trying to kill himself because of massive gambling debts. To save his father from some scary people, Guillaume makes a desperate choice. He teams up with his buddy Manu to dive headfirst into the dangerous world of selling drugs. The vibe here is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure as the clock ticks down and the stakes get higher.

You will really love how the tension builds up in every scene. The acting feels real, and you can tell Guillaume is totally out of his league, which makes the suspense work. Some parts of the story move a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about regular people getting in over their heads, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a very sad and stressful note. After trying so hard to pay off the debt, things spiral out of control. Guillaume realizes that the world of crime is a trap he cannot escape. The final scenes show that his efforts to save his father did not fix the underlying problems. He ends up losing his innocence and his peace of mind, proving that one bad choice can ruin a good life forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas about desperation and family loyalty.
